title: V1DeprecationMiddleware treats all current /api/v1/ routes as deprecated — log spam and incorrect headers
description: `V1DeprecationMiddleware.dispatch()` at line 756 triggers `_handle_v1_request` for any path containing `/api/v1/`. Since all production routes now use `/api/v1/` as their versioned prefix, every request hits the deprecation handler, emitting `logger.warning("V1 API request … V1 is SUNSET")` and adding `Warning`, `Sunset`, `Deprecation`, `X-API-Status: sunset` headers to every response. Clients receive misleading sunset headers on all API calls.
recommendation: The V1DeprecationMiddleware was designed to intercept legacy `/api/v1/` calls from external clients migrating from an old API. Now that `/api/v1/` IS the current stable prefix, either (a) remove the middleware, (b) update it to only block specific old path patterns that no longer exist (e.g. `/api/v1/stock/{symbol}` without the 's'), or (c) rename current routes to `/api/v2/`.
acceptance_test_hint: After fix: no `Warning` or `Sunset` header on `GET /api/v1/stocks`; log level drops to DEBUG for normal requests

title: V1DeprecationMiddleware registered but V1 endpoint map is stale
description: `V1_TO_V2_ENDPOINT_MAP` in versioning.py maps e.g. `/api/v1/stocks → /api/stocks` (no version) as V2 targets. But the actual V2 routes are at `/api/v1/stocks`. The migration router itself is at `/api/v1/admin/v1-migration/`. The map is entirely wrong relative to the current routing table. Any client that follows the redirect (if enable_redirects were True) would hit 404s.
recommendation: Audit and update `V1_TO_V2_ENDPOINT_MAP` to reflect current routing, or remove the map since V1 legacy patterns no longer exist in the codebase.
acceptance_test_hint: `map_v1_endpoint_to_v2()` unit test passes with current route structure

title: CacheControl and ETag excluded_paths reference /api/v1/auth/ patterns correctly but /api/v1/metrics missing
description: `CacheControlMiddleware` is configured with `cache_excluded_paths=["/api/v1/auth/", "/api/v1/admin/", "/api/v1/ws/", "/api/v1/metrics"]`. `ETagMiddleware` excludes `["/api/v1/auth/", "/api/v1/admin/", "/api/v1/ws/", "/api/health"]`. The metrics endpoint is at `/api/v1/metrics` (main.py:365) but ETag exclusion only has `/api/health`. Prometheus metrics response will get ETag headers added — inappropriate for frequently-changing metric data.
recommendation: Add `/api/v1/metrics` to ETagMiddleware's `excluded_paths` list. Also verify `/api/v1/ws/` path exclusion covers WebSocket upgrades (middleware may never see WS upgrade requests).

title: gdpr router double-registered at /api/v1 — may produce route collisions
description: `main.py:342` registers `gdpr.router` with `prefix="/api/v1"` (no subpath). If `gdpr.py` defines routes with paths like `/gdpr/...` they land at `/api/v1/gdpr/...` which is correct, but if it defines root-level routes (e.g. `@router.get("/")`) they would conflict with other routers. Needs verification that gdpr router paths all have the `/gdpr/` subpath in the router itself.
recommendation: Read gdpr.py route definitions and confirm there are no bare `/` routes that would collide. Add an explicit sub-prefix: `prefix="/api/v1/gdpr"`.
acceptance_test_hint: No duplicate route warnings in FastAPI startup logs

title: create_versioned_router() factory and version_manager.register_router() unused
description: `versioning.py:676-713` defines a `create_versioned_router()` factory function and the `APIVersionManager` class supports `register_router()`. Neither is called anywhere in main.py or any router. The only versioning mechanism in use is the `V1DeprecationMiddleware` and static URL prefix naming.
recommendation: Either use `create_versioned_router()` in main.py to create versioned routers properly, or remove the dead code to reduce confusion.
acceptance_test_hint: `grep -rn "create_versioned_router\ | register_router" backend/api/` returns only definition sites

title: Frontend API base paths omit `/v1` — all 40+ endpoints yield 404
description: All `apiConfig.endpoints.*` paths use `/api/auth/login`, `/api/stocks`, etc. Backend registers ALL routers under `/api/v1/` prefix (`main.py:333-348`). The Vite dev proxy rewrites `/api/` to backend but does not insert `/v1/`. Every non-thesis API call is 404 in all envs.
recommendation: Add `v1` segment to all paths in `api.config.ts` (e.g. `/api/v1/auth/login`) OR configure Vite proxy to rewrite `/api/` to `/api/v1/` at the proxy level. Prefer explicit paths.
acceptance_test_hint: Login succeeds and `localStorage.getItem('access_token')` is non-null after submit

title: Login thunk reads `response.data.token` but backend field is `access_token`
description: `appSlice.ts:68` — `localStorage.setItem('access_token', response.data.token)`. Backend `Token` schema at `auth.py:44` defines `access_token: str`. ApiResponse wraps it as `{ success, data: { access_token } }`. Frontend reads `response.data.token` — evaluates to `undefined`. Every login stores `undefined` as the auth token; all subsequent requests send `Bearer undefined`.
recommendation: Change line 68 to `localStorage.setItem('access_token', response.data.data?.access_token)` — or update the login thunk to destructure `{ data: { access_token } } = response`. Also log a warning if the value is undefined before storing.
acceptance_test_hint: `appSlice` login thunk test: mock response with `{ data: { access_token: 'tok' } }` and assert `localStorage.getItem('access_token') === 'tok'`
